text: USGS NAS Florida crocodile species list shows 2 nonindigenous crocodile species in FL: Crocodylus moreletii and Crocodylus niloticus. Nile Crocodile collection records in FL total 7, but only 6 fall within 2000-2020 (2009 x1, 2011 x1, 2012 x2, 2014 x2; 1988 x1 excluded). Morelet's Crocodile has 1 FL record in 2018. Sum for 2000-2020 = 7 collection records.
